title: Unveiling the nexus: exploring the relationship of e-satisfaction, e-trust, and online repurchase intentions among students in a developing country
core_idea: Investigate how e-customer satisfaction and e-trust relate to students' online repurchase intentions in Bangladesh, testing mediating roles of e-trust and e-satisfaction and the moderating effect of prior online experience using a quantitative survey and multivariate methods (SEM and 2SLS).
tldr: A quantitative study of 415 Bangladeshi students examines relationships among e-satisfaction, e-trust, and online repurchase intention, with mediation and moderation effects tested via SEM and a 2SLS robustness approach.
